claim: Produces an Evidence Synthesis: predeclared protocol, search log, screening flow, evidence table, conflict/bias analysis, calibrated certainty, and evidence gaps.

baseline.prompt: Write synthesis.md summarizing the evidence on whether daily standups improve software delivery outcomes. Cover what you know and how confident you are.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure produces the Evidence Synthesis elements.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write synthesis.md answering: 'Do daily standup meetings improve software delivery outcomes?' (decision use: whether to keep standups; scope: team-level studies and practitioner evidence). Follow the output contract: question/protocol/deviations, search log (sources, queries, dates, access limits), screening flow and inclusion/exclusion reasons, evidence table with provenance and findings, conflict/heterogeneity/bias analysis, synthesis by outcome including contrary evidence, calibrated certainty with claim boundary, and evidence gaps with update triggers.

tasks.description: Fresh-context baseline (no skill): same task, same Evidence-Synthesis oracle.
